title: The Marmalade Alibi
author: Barış Kısır
premise: When the town's beloved marmalade magnate dies at the annual preserve-tasting, sixty-year-old amateur sleuth Nora Vale is certain the killer is the jar of key-lime marmalade that should not exist. Armed with a sugar thermometer, a scandalous recipe diary, and her knitting, Nora must prove that the secret ingredient was murder.
short_description: When the marmalade magnate dies at the preserve tasting, retired teacher Nora Vale must prove the killer was a jar of key-lime marmalade that should not exist.
long_description: Brambleton, Vermont, 2009 — the 47th Annual Marmalade Festival. Homer Pettigrew, founder of Pettigrew Preserves, tastes the prize entry and drops dead, and Nora Vale, sixty-two, retired home-economics teacher and president of the Preservation Society, knows exactly what killed him: key-lime marmalade, which was not in the competition, and which Homer was violently allergic to. Armed with her sugar thermometer, a scandalous recipe diary unearthed from 1968, and knitting for cover, Nora unravels swapped labels, a botched batch, and an impossible alibi — and at the awards ceremony, with the killer cornered by a parking-lot chase, proves that the secret ingredient was murder.
main_characters: Nora Vale — sixty-two, sharp, kind, underestimated
Homer Pettigrew — the victim, beloved, complicated
Clara Pettigrew — the widow, cool, secretly relieved
Teddy Pettigrew — the nephew, feckless, golden
Marge Goodbody — rival jam-maker, loud, honest
Edgar Pine — food historian, precise, hiding something
Cyrus Pettigrew — the brother, bitter, wants the orchard
